senses.gloss: to cut branches off (for letting the sap drip), to tap.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 50b:4">Ab. Zar. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מְגַזְּמִין</he> you must not tap (in the festive week or in the Sabbath year).
Targ. Prov. XVI, 30) to threaten mischief.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>שהיא מְגַזֶּמֶת לעשות לו</he> which she was threatening to do unto him.
